name: Inagawa Junji: Mayonaka no Taxi
original_name: 稲川淳二 真夜中のタクシー
source:
Released on July 13th 2000, Junji Inagawa's Midnight Taxi is a PS1 horror visual novel developed by the Osaka based company, Visit. It is a sequel to their 1999 game, Junji Inagawa's Mansion of Terror. The player takes on the role of a taxi driver in Osore Cho 恐れ町 (literally Fear Town), listening to the various horror stories of their clients. You have the option to pick up or ignore clients, and the story changes depending on these decisions. Occasionally you will be attacked by paranormal phenomena, so it is still possible to get a game over.

There are 36 stories in total, including 4 hidden stories. Each of the stories are between ten and twenty minutes long. Ten of the stories are narrated by Mr Inagawa, while fourteen are narrated by other voice actors. The remaining eight stories have no narration and are only text based. There are certainly some famous ghost stories included in this collection, in particular 犬鳴峠 - Howling Dog Pass.

[From [url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/ps/578003-inagawa-junji-mayonaka-no-taxi/faqs/80348/introduction]gamefaqs[/url]]
translation:
稻川润二的《午夜出租车》于2000年7月13日发行，是由大阪公司Visit开发的PS1恐怖视觉小说。这是他们1999年的游戏《稻川润二的恐怖大厦》的续集。玩家扮演恐怖れ町的出租车司机，聆听客户的各种恐怖故事。你可以选择接听或忽略客户，故事会根据这些决定而变化。偶尔你会受到超自然现象的攻击，所以还是有可能结束游戏的。

共有36个故事，其中隐藏故事4个。每个故事的长度在十到二十分钟之间。其中十个故事由稻川先生讲述，十四个故事由其他声优讲述。其余八个故事没有旁白，只有文字。当然，这本小说集中也收录了一些著名的鬼故事，特别是《犬鸣峠》。

[来自[url=https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/ps/578003-inagawa-junji-mayonaka-no-taxi/faqs/80348/introduction]gamefaqs[/url]]
